ui.app.title: Primum
ui.outputs.heading: Outputs
ui.panic.description: Turns every output off and stops accepting commands.
ui.panic.active: Panic is active: every output is off and commands are refused.
ui.connection.offline: No connection with the service. Retrying…

hal.pin_in_use.message: Pin {pin} is already used by another output.
hal.pin_in_use.hint: Choose a different pin for one of them.

hal.pin_invalid.message: Pin {pin} does not exist on this board.
hal.pin_invalid.hint: Check the pin number against the board's pinout.

hal.pin_unavailable.message: Pin {pin} is being used by something else on this board.
hal.pin_unavailable.hint: Free it (stop the program or turn off the interface that uses it) or choose another pin.

hal.chip_unavailable.message: The GPIO controller {chip} cannot be opened.
hal.chip_unavailable.hint: Check that Primum is configured for this board.

hal.chip_access_denied.message: Primum has no permission to use the GPIO controller {chip}.
hal.chip_access_denied.hint: Add the user that runs Primum to the gpio group, then restart the service.

hal.unsupported_platform.message: Real hardware cannot be used on this system ({platform}).
hal.unsupported_platform.hint: Run Primum on a Raspberry Pi, or start it in simulation mode.

hal.closed.message: The connection to the hardware is closed.

hal.safe_state_incomplete.message: Pins {pins} could not be put in their safe state.
hal.safe_state_incomplete.hint: Cut the power of what is wired to them, then check the wiring.

hal.release_incomplete.hint: Restart the board before using them again.

output.unknown.hint: Reload the page to see the current outputs.

panic.active.message: Panic is active: outputs do not accept commands.
panic.active.hint: Release panic when it is safe to continue.

request.invalid.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

request.not_found.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

request.method_not_allowed.message: The service does not accept this action at {path}.
request.method_not_allowed.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.
